differences.what: A module, exam_peripheral_vascular, that the General note type includes: its section Peripheral vascular shows only while Peripheral Vascular (exam.systems is peripheral_vascular) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10

differences.what: The guidance line is not typed.

The pulse sites (lines 9 to 19) are two grids, each row a site recorded for the right and the left (sides), each cell choose-one from the shared list pulse_scale: 0, 1+, 2+, 3+, Unable to assess. Pulses holds the sites a routine exam palpates, Radial, Dorsalis pedis (DP) and Posterior tibial (PT), and Normal fills them with 2+. More pulse sites, collapsed, holds Ulnar, Femoral and Popliteal, and Normal leaves them empty: an optional part is left alone.
differences.why: PRD main 414; focused-exam inventory default 1, 23, 28; forms 4.3, 6.3; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): which sites are routine, for the clinical team to confirm. The inventory names none; DP and PT are the sites its worked example (1928 to 1990) and the foot exam (1692 to 1704) record, and Radial the pulse taken with the vitals

differences.what: 4+ is not a pulse grade: the one pulse scale stops at 3+.
Extremity findings is choose-many. Warm is the normal option; it does not clear the others, and it excludes Cool.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory 3.11, default 13, 17, 25, 26; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): Warm is kept with Edema and the rest rather than cleared by them

differences.what: Capillary refill: _____ seconds is a number, Capillary refill time, in seconds from 2 to 10 with one decimal, asked after the choice and only while Capillary refill is Greater than 2 seconds, so a measured time and the choice never disagree. Normal leaves it empty.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 42; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): a refill time is charted only when it is prolonged, so one-tap Normal never fills Less than 2 seconds beside a measured 4 seconds

differences.what: The two refill bullets are a choose-one, Capillary refill, from the shared list capillary_refill, whose normal option is Less than 2 seconds. It comes before the time it opens. Neither field is worked out from the other: the choice is kept and the number is optional.
Vascular symptoms is choose-many, with no normal option.
Temperature change (Oct 19) stays an option and, while picked, shows a choose-one, Temperature change: Warm or Cool.
